name: Tibalt
description: Tibalt was a uninhabited planet that was fully covered in mountains, hills, and plains. At some time before the Battle over Tibalt, another battle between the Alliance to Restore the Republic and the Galactic Empire happen on Tibalt's surface. The planet had an atmosphere breathable to oxygen-breathers, such as humans.
